en.headline: Liu Huiyin takes Hong Kong’s first gold of the Asian Para Games in boccia
en.dek: She defeated teammate Zhang Yuan 7-2 in the women’s BC4 final, securing gold and silver for the SAR as the team added more medals on Wednesday.
body: Hong Kong, China claimed its first gold medal of the Aichi-Nagoya 2026 Asian Para Games when Liu Huiyin defeated teammate Zhang Yuan 7-2 in the women’s boccia BC4 final on Wednesday afternoon.

The Hong Kong Paralympic Committee said Liu led 3-0 after the first end, then added two points in each of the next two ends to build a 7-0 lead before Zhang took the fourth end 2-0. Liu finished 7-2. The all-Hong Kong final guaranteed the SAR both gold and silver in the event.

On the same day the boccia team added further medals: Leung Yuk-wing took silver in the men’s BC4, Yeung Hiu-lam silver in the women’s BC2, and John Loung bronze in the men’s BC1. The results were confirmed by the Hong Kong Paralympic Committee.

zh.headline: 劉慧茵奪亞殘運港隊首金 硬地滾球女子BC4擊敗張沅
zh.dek: 她在決賽以7比2擊敗隊友張沅，為港隊包辦該項目金銀牌，同日硬地滾球隊再添多面獎牌。
body: 中國香港隊在愛知-名古屋2026年亞殘運會奪得今屆首面金牌。硬地滾球選手劉慧茵周三下午在女子BC4級個人賽決賽以7比2擊敗隊友張沅封后。
中國香港殘疾人奧委會表示，劉慧茵首局領先3比0，其後兩局各取2分，一度以7比0領先，張沅雖在第四局以2比0扳回一局，最終仍以7比2落敗。全港對決確保港隊在該項目包辦金銀牌。
同日硬地滾球隊再添獎牌：梁育榮在男子BC4奪銀，楊曉林在女子BC2奪銀，龍子健在男子BC1奪銅。成績由中國香港殘疾人奧委會確認。
